breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed procedure for 'Strang splitting'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified that Strang splitting was the intended method, stating 'The time integration method is Strang splitting' and accurately describing its steps, while completely omitting the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. This perfectly matches the resolution in the ground truth.
